title: BANZA Conformance Report
description: Canonical format for conformance test results produced by the BANZA conformance runner.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

runner_version.description: Version of the conformance runner that produced this report.

operator_url.description: Base URL of the operator under test.

operator_id.description: operator_id declared in the operator manifest, if available.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version being tested against.

suite_version.description: Version of the conformance suite (vectors + runner) this report was produced against.

certification_level_achieved.description: The highest certification level fully passed. -1 if no level passed. 0–4 per the normative profile registry (contracts/production/conformance-profiles.production.json). Note: the sandbox runner awards at most L3; L4 (External Interoperability) is profile-defined.

certification_level_name.description: Canonical name of the achieved level (Protocol Sandbox, Core Payment Capability, Payment Initiation Capability, Inter-Operator Interoperability, External Interoperability, or None).

evidence.description: Provenance metadata. A report alone is NOT a certification; certification requires recorded provenance per contracts/production/conformance-profiles.production.json and the evidence contracts it names.

suites.description: Results for each conformance suite executed.

errors.description: Top-level runner errors (connectivity failures, auth errors, etc.).

Evidence.description: Provenance and environment metadata for the report. Required for any certification claim; the runner output alone is not a certification.

suite_commit.description: Git commit of the suite that produced this report, if recorded.

simulated.description: Whether the operator under test declared simulated=true (sandbox). A simulated run cannot ground a production certification claim.

certification_level_name.description: Canonical name of the suite's level.

id.description: Vector or case ID, e.g. TRF-001, QR-002, EVT-004.

request.description: The HTTP request sent, for debugging.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of what failed and why.

assertion.description: What was checked, e.g. 'status == 200', 'response.id starts with txfr-'.
